authority: Latest user continuation: 继续改啊，直到达到目标才能停. Continue original quant PR1 implementation and evidence-supported redesign; do not infer a new permanent one-experiment approval cap from a preregistration. Closed earlier experiments remain closed and immutable.
hypothesis: Rank already eligible funded opportunities by the conditional arithmetic net payoff of actually settled campaigns of the unchanged causal control, rather than fixed-horizon cross-sectional rank accuracy.

evidence.finding: Joint-removal pair accuracy and exposure rose while wealth fell. Its large control winners span variable multi-week holdings with partial funding/protective sales. Their realized payoff is not the previous fixed ten-session return target. Lost symbol contributions are not freely recoverable profit or a causal upper bound.

control: Unchanged observed_admission_completion Owner and Config, replayed once per scope at the same source/runtime/cost/delay as treatment; the same control result supplies the shadow learning ledger.

treatment.samples: Use research.ledger_attribution.attribute on the exact same-scope control result. One sample per completely sold holding episode; initial signal-session features, actual final sale-session maturity, target net cash PnL divided by all actual buy notional. Include fees and partial buys/sells already in that ledger. OPEN episodes are censored, never treated as zero or marked-to-market training labels.
treatment.causality: At decision session i, use only episodes whose final actual sale session is <=i. Origin is the signal preceding first actual buy, not the eventual winner's best retrospective entry. The fixed shadow control is causal and independent of the treatment; no future control target, open holding mark, current/future label or removed name is available to ranking.
treatment.features: Reuse only relative_rank.cohort_features: three causal log-price changes at unchanged Config.fast, Config.slow and 4*Config.slow, standardized within each current ready cross section. Reuse rank_order; do not reuse learn_relative_rank or its labels.
treatment.fit: Every unchanged Config.rebalance sessions, fit all available settled episodes since sample start with equal episode weight. Require at least twice the feature dimension and two distinct symbols. Center and standardize training X, center arithmetic payoff y, ridge penalty 1.0 on mean cross-product. No payoff sign conversion, log transform, clipping, sample/window/model/penalty search or named-stock rules.
treatment.fallback: Original priority when a fit or any supplied eligible feature is unavailable, or fitted coefficients are zero/nonfinite. Original score then symbol breaks predicted-payoff ties.
treatment.application: Change only the two existing funding-order hooks: original allocation and original fresh-admission completion. Preserve eligibility, actual-unit holding, stops, all pending protective obligations, risk authority, slots, cash, concentration, funding amounts and execution. Predictions cannot create admission authority, force swaps, or exempt a protective exit.
treatment.reference_identity: Reject reference-ledger injection unless market fingerprint, universe, source, Config, policy identity, costs and delay match the freshly specified control. Preserve complete control accounts, settled samples, issued predictions, fit maturity and hashes.

screen: Immutable existing decision_review.paired_screen through 2025-12-31: matched control and treatment on union/common five/joint optical-leader removal; each pool wealth nondecreasing and MDD nonincreasing, at least one strict improvement. Preserve orders, exposure, turnover, blocked attempts and ledger reconciliation. Screen is not final economic acceptance.
scope_boundary: One fixed control/treatment mechanism, no parameter grid. A rejected mechanism gets no neighboring changes or treatment-2026 replay. Failure triggers saved-account diagnosis and, only with a substantively distinct justified mechanism, a new prospective contract under latest user authority; this is not task completion or an automatic permission/budget reset.
advance: If the original screen passes, evaluate that exact treatment over full history and both original 2026 crash windows; retain full-matrix obligations for a stable final production candidate. No per-pool winner splicing or old-SHA relabeling.
limitations: The control's executed episodes are a selected sparse training population, not all feasible opportunities or unbiased causal labels.
Unsettled long winners are unavailable until actually sold; censoring and distribution shift may make this hypothesis fail.
Training payoff belongs to the frozen shadow control, not a promised payoff of the treatment's different funded path.
Adjusted economic-unit accounting remains distinct from a verified actual-share/corporate-action ledger.
Original acceptance is unchanged; conflicting historical descriptions of Config.risk_drawdown=0.18 must be resolved from authority before any promotion.
